    Cover paths and piece paths #

    In a convex piece S, a path of the cover between points of S lifts to a path of the piece with the same composite (piece_of_cover_path), and a piece path gives a cover path with the same value (cover_of_piece_path).

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.piece_of_cover_path {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] {x₀ : P} {S : Finset (Cover x₀)} (hS : Cover.Convex ↑S) (i : (pieceQuiver S).V) {d : RayVert (Cover x₀)} (p : Quiver.Path (RayVert.mk (pt S i)) d) (hd : d.out ∈ S) :
    ∃ (le : List (pieceQuiver S).A) (h : FinQuiver.PathFrom i le ⟨d.out, hd⟩), compD S le i ⟨d.out, hd⟩ h = pathVal p

    Cover paths inside a convex piece are piece paths.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.cover_of_piece_path {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] {x₀ : P} {S : Finset (Cover x₀)} (le : List (pieceQuiver S).A) {i j : (pieceQuiver S).V} (h : FinQuiver.PathFrom i le j) :
    ∃ (p : Quiver.Path (RayVert.mk (pt S i)) (RayVert.mk (pt S j))), pathVal p = compD S le i j h
